task_test_mapping.task: Set `head` and `tail` on the new queue to `None`.
Set the new queue's `size` to zero.

lesson_reviews.note: Empty head/tail/size and per-instance ownership are separate constructor checks.

task_test_mapping.task: Handle an empty queue in `enqueue`: link the new node as both endpoints and increase size.
Handle a nonempty queue: link after the old tail and advance tail and size.

lesson_reviews.note: Empty singleton and occupied rear link preserve FIFO order and node identity.

task_test_mapping.task: Raise `IndexError` when `dequeue` receives an empty queue.
Remove and detach the head of a queue with multiple nodes, returning its value and reducing size.
Clear tail when removal empties the queue.

lesson_reviews.note: Empty rejection, detach/return, and singleton tail reset have cumulative checks.

task_test_mapping.task: Raise `IndexError` when `peek` receives an empty queue.
Return the head value without changing a nonempty queue.

lesson_reviews.note: Read-only peek distinguishes an empty queue from a stored None.

task_test_mapping.task: Implement the `right` command with a rear append.
Implement the `left` command with a front append.
Implement `take_left`, recording the removed value only when an item exists.
Implement `take_right` with the same empty-removal policy.
Raise `ValueError` for an unknown command.

lesson_reviews.note: Four deque end operations and unknown-command rejection each have a row.

task_test_mapping.task: Reject an invalid capacity with `ValueError`.
Allocate an independent `data` list containing capacity empty slots.
Initialize `head` and `size` to zero.

lesson_reviews.note: Exact positive capacity, independent storage, and initial indices are staged.

task_test_mapping.task: Raise `OverflowError` for a full ring without changing it.
Write the value into the wrapped rear slot without moving head.
Increase size after a successful write.

lesson_reviews.note: Full rejection, modulo rear write, and size update preserve fixed capacity.

task_test_mapping.task: Raise `IndexError` for an empty ring without changing it.
Save, clear, and return the value in the head slot.
Advance head with wraparound and reduce size after removal.

lesson_reviews.note: Empty rejection, clearing the old slot, and modulo head/size transitions are staged.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `validate_jobs` to reject negative, boolean, and noninteger work counts.
Complete `queue_jobs` to enqueue only positive-work pairs in arrival order.
Complete `round_robin` to service one unit per turn and requeue unfinished jobs.

lesson_reviews.note: Validation, positive-job queueing, and fair one-unit turns are isolated helpers.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `validate_window` with the width and empty-input rules.
Complete `advance_candidates` to expire old indices, discard dominated rear candidates, and append the current index.
Complete `window_maxima` to call both helpers and collect the front value after each full window.

lesson_reviews.note: Width check, dominated/expired candidate transition, and full-window collection are staged.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `validate_capacity` to accept positive integers other than bool and reject everything else with `ValueError`.
Complete `bucket_index` to call validation and fold the string characters into a rolling bucket index.

lesson_reviews.note: Capacity validation precedes a deterministic rolling Unicode hash.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `empty_buckets` to validate capacity and return independent empty bucket lists.
Complete `collision_buckets` to append every key occurrence to its computed bucket.

lesson_reviews.note: Independent bucket allocation precedes occurrence-preserving distribution.

task_test_mapping.task: Allocate independent empty buckets in `HashTable.__init__` after the supplied capacity check.
Initialize the distinct-key count `size` to zero.

lesson_reviews.note: Fresh nested bucket lists and distinct-key counter are separate changes.

task_test_mapping.task: Append a pair and increase size when its key is not already in the bucket.
Replace the value of an equal key without adding a pair or changing size.

lesson_reviews.note: No-match insertion precedes equal-key replacement without size growth.

task_test_mapping.task: Raise `KeyError(key)` after a bucket scan finds no equal key.
Return the value from an equal pair without changing the table.

lesson_reviews.note: Absent-key KeyError precedes read-only retrieval of false-looking values.

task_test_mapping.task: Return `False` when no equal key exists.
Remove the matching pair and return `True` when it exists.
Decrease size once for each successful removal.

lesson_reviews.note: Miss, one-pair removal, and success-only size change are separately checked.

task_test_mapping.task: Collect the bucket pairs into a new shallow list in traversal order.

lesson_reviews.note: Fresh shallow snapshot follows bucket traversal order; one cohesive operation.

task_test_mapping.task: Return `size / len(buckets)` from `load_factor`.

lesson_reviews.note: Single ratio calculation counts keys over all buckets; no gratuitous split.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `redistribute_entries` to put each stored pair into fresh buckets using its key.
Complete `rehash` to validate first, snapshot the pairs, and replace the bucket collection with the helper result.

lesson_reviews.note: Fresh redistribution precedes validated replacement; keys rehash under new capacity.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `probe_slot` to wrap a home index plus an offset into the slot range.
Report a missing key at an untouched slot or after a full unsuccessful probe cycle.
Return an equal live pair's value, continuing past collisions and tombstones.

lesson_reviews.note: Wrapped probe index, bounded miss, and collision/tombstone success have separate checks.

main.py.stdout: list indices must be integers or slices, not NoneType

task_test_mapping.task: Return `False` when a bounded probe finds no live equal key.
Replace an equal live pair with `_DELETED` and return `True`.
Reduce size only when a live pair was marked deleted.

lesson_reviews.note: Miss, tombstone replacement, and live-key count preserve probe reachability.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `increment_count` to create a count of one or increase an existing count.
Complete `frequency_index` to create the sized table and apply that helper to each word.

lesson_reviews.note: One count increment precedes new-table allocation and the word loop.

task_test_mapping.task: Return `-1` after the scan finishes without a match.
Return the first equal item's index from inside the scan.

lesson_reviews.note: Missing -1 and first-match return are separate loop checkpoints.

task_test_mapping.task: Return `-1` when no extracted key matches the target.
Return the first matching record index while calling the key function once per visited record.

lesson_reviews.note: Missing case and first match check callback order and one call per visited row.

task_test_mapping.task: Return `-1` when the candidate interval is empty.
Replace the loop pause with midpoint comparison, strict interval updates, and an equal-index return.

lesson_reviews.note: Empty interval precedes bounded midpoint halving and any-match policy.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `validate_bounds` with the half-open integer-bound rules.
Return `-1` for a valid empty search interval.
Replace the loop pause with a binary search confined to the supplied bounds.

lesson_reviews.note: Bound validation, empty region, and confined search preserve original indices.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `lower_step` to return the next half-open bounds for one nonempty interval.
Complete `lower_bound` to repeat that step until the bounds meet and return the boundary.

lesson_reviews.note: One interval transition precedes repeated first-greater-or-equal search.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `upper_step` to move equality into the left partition when returning new bounds.
Complete `upper_bound` to repeat the step and return the first strictly-greater position.

lesson_reviews.note: Equality-right transition precedes the first-strictly-greater boundary.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `shift_right` to add a temporary slot and move the suffix right, copying backward.
Complete `insert_sorted` to find the upper bound, call the shift helper, write target, and return its position.

lesson_reviews.note: Backward shift helper precedes upper-bound insertion; repaired delegation check.

task_test_mapping.task: Complete `compare_at` to call the comparator once for the requested item and return its relation.
Complete `measured_binary_search` to halve the interval and count the actual calls to that helper.

lesson_reviews.note: One comparator invocation per midpoint is isolated from measured halving loop.

repairs.change: Assert upper_bound is followed by shift_right on the original list, with restored spies; reject a correct-output implementation that bypasses the taught helper.
repairs.verification: Reference vector [true,true], correct-output/helper-bypass mutant [true,false]; all cumulative prefixes still pass.

preexisting_partial_edits: The interrupted review had already changed prose in 26 lessons and the sorted-insertion test before this pass; those edits were read and retained. The author audit is a before-hash baseline, not final-source acceptance.

verification.method: Actual backend ContentLoader plus isolated native CPython 3.12.12 Submit-style synchronous test functions; not the browser Pyodide worker.
verification.asset_copier: Frontend copy-lesson-images.mjs run from scratch; all 26 scoped images match published copies byte-for-byte.
verification.quiz_answers: Backend loader discovered four questions per scoped module; the question files and author audit answer keys were read.

remaining_issues: Browser/Worker Run, Submit and navigation were excluded by the user and are not claimed.
Visual layout at actual lesson-pane widths was not tested; local thumbnails are not UI acceptance.
